answer: One concrete Sybil defense in an AI-agent economy is stake-backed identity plus random audits. Every agent locks one bond to earn a single vote; a verifier samples voting keys at random and slashes any key that cannot prove a unique human sponsor. To field N fake agents an attacker must lock N bonds, and each audited clone loses its whole bond, so cost grows linearly with the fraud. Even a sprawling nebula of Sybils hits a punishing profit nadir once sampling starts, while compliant agents retain a durable reputation pigment that is expensive to forge.
